violation_type.title: Infant Care Area - Able to See, Hear and Intervene (26 TAC §747.2303(1))
violation_type.short_title: Infant Care Area - Able to See, Hear and Intervene
violation_type.typical_finding: During an inspection, it was observed that two infant play yard's had a sheet covering the mesh side so if the infants were sleeping, they could not be seen. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the sheet.
